draft.emotion: eager and honest, expressing a simple personal desire
notes: Takes the particle が for the desired thing (靴が欲しい 'I want shoes'), and connects to the て-form of a verb when wanting someone else to do something (来て欲しい 'I want you to come').
Used normally only for the speaker's own desires (or in questions to the listener). To say you want to do an action yourself, use the ～たい form of the verb instead (行きたい 'I want to go').
